description: 用户输入相互冲突,Agent 必须指出冲突并请用户选择,不能静默处理

user_messages: 但是是关于妈妈去世的

expected_flow.conflict_description: 用户说'快乐的歌'但主题是'妈妈去世',情绪表达方向冲突
must_offer_options: 保留冲突(可能是回忆中的反差美学)

expected_flow.conflict_description: BPM 120(快)和 pace=slow_contemplative(慢沉思)直接冲突

expected_decision_points.must_offer_creative_resolution: 保留冲突可作为艺术选择

must_not_happen: silently pick one side and ignore the other
use hallucinated averages (e.g., BPM 100 as compromise)
right_behaviors: explicitly name the conflict in plain language
explain why the two inputs may not work together
offer 3+ resolution paths (keep conflict / pick one / reframe)
